scope: one prospective MSSP planning case, not an externally validated classification tool

claims.unit_and_scope: Detailed capability count vs spreadsheet helper count
claims.assumption_class: do not conflate a helper/narrative count with typed enumeration
claims.witness_or_missing: 49 versus 51 discordance; narrower typed row enumeration identifies 51
claims.minimum_new_evidence: approved reconciled definition/erratum of helper and scope

claims.claim: Detailed capabilities all map once to packages
claims.assumption_class: exact-match name equality at the source snapshot
claims.minimum_new_evidence: not required for source membership; separate service obligation proof not provided

claims.claim: Recover strict component predicate from Provided/Expandable package label
claims.witness_or_missing: S06 and S07 opposite strict values
claims.minimum_new_evidence: retain exact component status vector and declared full-scope acceptance rule

claims.claim: Unique top focus from scorecard alone
claims.assumption_class: diagnostic weighted sum over normalized nonnegative weights, not asserted company rule
claims.witness_or_missing: Firewall equal weights; DSPM SOC-only; Human Risk demand-only
claims.minimum_new_evidence: approved aggregation, weights, tie rule and versioned decision record

claims.claim: Packages staged at first full-scope readiness
claims.unit_and_scope: package staged year versus component years
claims.assumption_class: all-components-at-launch is illustrative, broad milestone rule even stronger
claims.witness_or_missing: planned launch vs full-scope maturity semantics diverge
claims.minimum_new_evidence: approved service tier, scope and acceptance timestamp

claims.claim: Individual service revenue and delay economics from family totals
claims.assumption_class: nonnegative additive service-level decomposition as hypothetical favorable case
claims.witness_or_missing: two normalized positive allocations (0.5,0.5) and (0.75,0.25) with identical total; rank-nullity 57-12=45
claims.minimum_new_evidence: per-service price/volume rules plus contracts, attributable costs, schedule and displacement assumptions

source_pointer: S5 and S6 90-day plan and exit criteria
claims.assumption_class: an observation must exist to assert implementation
claims.witness_or_missing: no dated authorization, client acceptance or SLA closeout in admitted archive
claims.minimum_new_evidence: dated approvals, signed acceptance, lighthouse/pilot and SLA evidence

claims.witness_or_missing: signed executive approval not in admitted archive
